text: APPROVE. I traced the extracted helpers (`CommentEnd`, `BlankRange`, `LexLiteral`, `LexRawString`, `StringEnd`) against the original branches and found no difference in comment, raw-string, verbatim or escape handling, or in literal offsets and blanking. `Lex` itself is now a single loop with one `if`/`else if`/`else` chain, well under 15. I could not compile it here, so the build is unchecked, and I could not confirm the new helper names don't already exist elsewhere in the class.
